senses.gloss: made by people rather than occurring naturally

definition_translations.zh_TW: 由人製造而非自然形成的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 自然に生じたものではなく、人によって作られた
definition_translations.ko_KR: 자연적으로 생긴 것이 아니라 사람이 만든
definition_translations.vi_VN: do con người tạo ra thay vì hình thành tự nhiên
definition_translations.th_TH: มนุษย์สร้างขึ้นแทนที่จะเกิดขึ้นเองตามธรรมชาติ

senses.example: Her artificial enthusiasm failed to convince the visiting clients.

definition_translations.ja_JP: 誠実さや本物らしさがない
